relationships.subject: PANX1
relationships.evidence_quote: This activation of P2X7 receptors initiates a signaling cascade, ultimately leading to the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome, Pro-caspase-1 cleavage, and the conversion of Pro-IL-1β into IL-1β [28].

key_findings: THCV, CBC and CBN reduced IL-1beta, IL-6, COX-2 and NLRP3 inflammasome activation in LPS+ATP THP-1 macrophages.
Effects involve reduced NF-kB, STAT-3 and PANX1/P2X7 axis signaling, with differences between cannabinoids.
